label: lem : algebra
title: Lemma
body_md:
Let $p$ and $q$ be nonnegative real numbers where $p<q$, let $D:=[p,q]$, and let $f : D^2\mapsto \mathbb{R}$ be the function $f(x,y):=y(p+q-x)+x(p+q-y)$. Then $f(x,y)\geqslant 2pq$ for each $(x,y)\in D^2$.                                           
    \label{lem : algebra}

label: prop : 2k-cut
title: Proposition
body_md:
Let $G$ be a graph obtained from a tree $T$ by isomorphic \mbox{$k$-leaf} matching where $k\geqslant 1$; adopt notation from Definition \ref{defn : kisojoin}. For an edge $e$ of $H\cup H'$, let $e_i$ and $e_i'$ denote the copies of $e$ in $T_i$ and $T_i'$, respectively, for each $i\in \{1,2,\dots,k\}$. Then, the set $\{e_1,e_2,\dots ,e_k,e_1',e_2',\dots, e_k'\}$ is a $2k$-cut of $G$ containing the edge $e$. \qed
    \label{prop : 2k-cut}

label: lem : base case double star
title: Lemma
body_md:

    \label{lem : base case double star}

    \label{cor : G-uy-vx is k-1 ex}

label: lem : induction step (k,r)-extension
